Keep per-pool alias conflict validation and permit pool-specific revision identifiers when the aggregate unit/time match.
Add negative tests for unlike units and unlike timestamps; retain positive multi-pool aggregation.
Run the focused capacity contract and Rust formatting checks.

acceptance: A single aggregate may only sum distinct pools with matching unit and as-of UTC second.
Same-pool aliases must still agree on unit, revision, timestamp and full snapshot.
The positive distinct-pool aggregation remains unchanged, and mixed-unit/time negatives fail closed.
No ED, Kairos, schema, dependency or lockfile change.
